tei:div.tei:p: (219)'um̐ḥ klong snying phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon gyi gtor bzlog drang srong dmod pa'i gad rgyang zhes bya ba bzhugs so: (220)badzra ku mā ra na mo:

rjogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon gyi smad kyi las rnams zur du bkol ba la/ sngon 'gro bcas kyi shoms rnams mthong brgyud ltar tshags su tshud nas/ dngos gzhi ye shes lha'i bsnyen pa dpal chen 'dus pa'i las byang gis khog dbub 'byin 'jug rnams ma nor bar nyams su bstar nas rjes tshogs mchod lhag ma yan grub par byas te smad kyi las la spyi don bcu gcig las/ dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ mi gnas ye shes chos sku'i pho brang nas: longs spyod rdzogs pa zhi dang khro bo'i lha: thugs dam bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: rig pa'i rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po yang : ma rig 'jin pa'i kun gzhi lung ma bstan: sgo lnga'i yul dang rten cing 'brel ba las: rigs drug rgyud lnga'i gnas su 'khyam pa rnams: las dang nyon mongs mthu yis gzir ba'i mthus: phyi rol yul la smin pa'i sdug bsngal dang : nad mtshon mu ge dgra bgegs 'byung po'i gdon: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug kun: mngon spyod drag po'i rol pas tshar bcad nas: log (221)rtog dngos por zhen pa'i sems can rnams: rgyu 'bras theg pa gzhan gyis gdul dka' bas: rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i phrin las mjod: gnyis pa gser skyems ni: hūm̐ḥ rig 'jin rtsa brgyud sogs btang : gsum pa gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po nas bzung ste: mngon par byang chub dpal mgon bla ma'i bar: dgongs brda snyan brgyud rdo rje slob dpon dang : dpal chen phur pa'i lha tshogs gzu dang dbang : 'gro kun bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin la: dgra gnyen phyogs cha'i sdang zhen ma dmigs kyang : gzung 'jin gdon gyis brlams pa'i nyams pa bdun: byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa'i dgra ru langs: dam las nyams pas slob dpon mched la brnyas: bka' las nyams pas las 'bras khyud du bsad:

don las nyams pas bden gnyis chad par lta: las kyis nyams pas nyes med rnams la 'jug: mtshan mas nyams pas chos la phyogs ris bzung : 'dod pas nyams pas 'khrel (222)med 'phrog bcom byas: log pas nyams pas sems can sdug la sbyor: 'di la mngon spyod phrin las mi mjad na: mthar gyi 'chi ba sems can kun la yod: dus la bab na dpag bsam shing yang 'gyel: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin na: tshad gcod rjais 'jin mthu stobs rdzun du zad: chos nid bden pa bslu ba med pa dang : sngags kyi sgrol ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthu: a bhi tsarya'i dus la da bab na: brnag pa'i las la btang snyoms ma mjad cig: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams ni dbyings nas gzigs: bden gnyis rgyu 'bras bslu med gzu dang dpang : dpal mgon chos skyong rnams kyis mthu rtsal bskyed: nyes can 'di la mngon spyod phrin las mjod: ces brjod yus gdab/ bzhi pa phur pa rang gzhung gi sgos chos la gsum ste/ dang po gab pa'i sngags drug bstan bstab dang*/ tshe lung khrus lung bstan pa/ gdab pa dngos bstan pa'o/ dang po smad las 'di dgra bgegs rtsad nas bcad phyir rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste/ phur pa khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i rgyud la/ dkon mchog (223) dbu 'phang smod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa dang*/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang*/ theg chen chos la smod pa dang*/ bla ma'i skaku la brdo ba dang*/ rdo rje'i nang du dbyin spyod pa/ sgrub la bar chad byed pa dang*/ gang zhig dam las log pa dang*/ snying rje med pa'i srin po dang*/ mu stegs log par gtong ba dang*/ sgrub pa po la do brdo ba/ 'di rnams bsgral ba'i zhing bcu'o/ zhes pas/ de yang rgyud kyi dgongs pa gab pa'i sngags drug 'di la bzhi ste/ mngon spyod kyi las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin pas/ kun gyi sna 'dren du btang ba dang*/ sgrub pa thams cad kyi ngo bo yin pas dkyus kyi khong khrar btang ba dang*/

las thams cad kyi mjug sdud yin pas smon lam gyi tshul du gdab pa dang*/ drag sngags yin pas na sngags su byas te srog la 'khor lo bskor ba dang bzhi las/ 'dir sgrub pa dkyus kyi khong khrar btang ba la/ rgyud las lha dpral gnas nas dgugs pa dang*/ rnam shes gzugs bstim bya du bzhugs/ smyor gzhugs rdul du brlag pa dang*/ sha khrag zhal du bstabs pa dgyes/ 'di drug shais na las drug 'grub/ ces pas rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa las drug re re la bcu bcu ste drug cu tham par bshad de/ gang zhe na/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha drug ngan sngags kyi phur pa drug gdab pa sngags kyi phur pa drug bskul bar bya ba'i pho nya drug (224) gdags pa'i 'phyong drug bsags par bya ba'i rdzas drug bzla bya'i sngags drug bca' ba'i phyag rgya drug gdab pa'i smon lam drug ting nge 'jin drug ste bcu'o/ dang po lha dang dpral ba la bcu ste/ gnyen po stobs kyi lha bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ste/ tshindha sogs/ 'jig rten pa'i lha rdo rje legs pa'o/ gnyis pa gdab pa gnad kyi phur pa seng ldong dmar po'i phur pa'o/ gsum pa gdab pa'i gnad spyi gtsug tu gdab ste/ gnam gyi 'ju thag bcad pa'i phyir te/ bzhi pa bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: ces dang*/ dkyus tshig khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ mthu rtsal byung ba'i dus la bab: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa: stobs chen khro bo chen po yis: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams: nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na: lnga pa gdab pa'i 'phyong*/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ tsi dha dha hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes pa dang*/ de yang las drug po re re nas bab brgya dam tshig gsum ma rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig drug po byar ba las dkyus kyi khong khrar btang tshul 'gres so/ drug pa rdzas ni/

gu gul (225) khyi lud/ tshil chen/ lh+wam 'bol/ rta go gi brun no/ bdun pa sngags ni/ de bzhin nyid don kyi dbu non dang*/ kī la ya sngags kyi dbu non/ dus la bab tshig gis dbu non yin pas kī la ya kun la 'gres shes par bya'o/ bdun pa sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ja hūm̐ bam̐ ho: che ge mo ma ra ya ha sa ra ya hri da ya sarba bighnan bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa'o/ brgyad pa bca' ba'i phyag rgya/ dud pa bdug pa'i tshul dang dngos su'ang bdug go dbu pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs yul phyogs lha klu rnams kyi bden pas dam nyams pa'i che ge mo 'di/ pho lha dang phrol cig mo lha dang phrol cig dgra lha dang phrol cig zhing lha dang phrol cig che lha dang phrol cig srog lha dang phrol cig yul lha dang phrol cig bcu pa ting 'jin ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sprul pa dang yang sprul mang po/ gu gul gyi dud pa thogs pa mang po byung ste/ bdug pas che ge mo lha dang phral te mi med pa'i grong stong ma/ bya khyur 'ur rdo 'phang ba bzhin du gyur te/ brnag pa de kho na gcig (226)pur lus pa ltar bsamamo/ gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa la bcu ste/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha mi g.yo mgon po ste/ bhandha sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha yam shud dmar po'o/ gnyis pa gdab phur bya rgod kyi phur pa'o/ gsum pa gdab pa'i gnad rkang pa'i mthil du gdab ste/ pa'i rten phur byung ba'o bzhi pa pho nya ni/ dkyus tshig hūm̐ḥ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ zhes dang*/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i/ lnga pa 'phyong ni/ gong gi tshig drug sbyor mthar/ mchan/ phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ drug pa sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kī/ nas ja hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbar kun la sbyor a we sha ya a we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bdun pa phyag rgya 'debs tshul bya ba'o/

brgyad pa rdzas ni/ mtshe nag yungs dkar nag yug pa'i zhabs pa'o/ dgungs ting nge 'jin ni/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis gzas po bkug la liṅka la bstim mo/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bden pas dgra bgegs che ge 'dir khug cig phog cig bstim cig zhes brjod do/ gsum pa byang du bcug pa la bcu ste/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyis lha khams gsum rnam rgyal te/ bhinha saugs dang*/ las kyi lha (227) klu'i rgyal po'o/ gnyis pa mchog phur ro/ gsum pa gsang gnas su gdab ste skye ba dgu rgyud bcad pa'i phyir ro/ bzhi pa bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ hūm̐ḥ phyag brnyan bachen pa'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig mthu rtsal pyung ba'i/ lnga pa 'phyong ni/ zungs cig rgyob cig rnam par ching*/ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ drug pa sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kī li sogs nas shrī ghraṃ a na ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bdun pa phyag ragaya bcing ba'i tshul lo/ brgyad pa rdzas ni bal sna lnga'i skud pa dkar nag rnams so/ dgu pa ting nge 'jin ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas zhags pa thogs pa mang po byung te gru gu thul du bcing bar bsam/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ ho/ rdo rje gzhon nu dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bden pas che ge mo 'di lha'i byang du chug cig klu'i byad du chug cig gnod sbyin gyi byad du chug cig me lha'i byad du chug cig ces so/ bzhi pa smyor gzhugs sa la bcu las/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha rta mgrin ste/ ghrihna sogs/ las kyi lha rgyal po be dkar ro/ gnyis pa tsaṇḍa dmar po'i phur pa'o/ gsum pa lce dkyil du gdab ste ngag 'joms pa'o/ bzhi pa bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ hūm̐ḥ shwa na (228)mu kha'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig mthu rtsal phyung ba'i/ lnga pa 'phyong ni/ ring bar khug la smyor chug cig ghrihna ghrihna hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa'o/ drug pa sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kī li sogs nas dzwa la sa ya dzwa la sa ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

bdun pa phyag rgya bcing tshul bya'o/ brgyad pa rdzas la rda rdu ra dang dug chu'o/ dgu pa ting nge 'jin ni/ snying ka nas 'od zer tsha tsha lta bu 'phros/ smyos shing brgyal/ myos shing 'bog khong nas me 'bar/ bu ga gu nas khrag 'jag par bsam mo/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ dgra bo che ge mo smyo ru chug 'bog tu chug myos su chug ces pa'o/ lnga pa rdul du rlag pa la bcu ste/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha dbyug pa sngon po'o/ ha na sogs/ las kyi bdud do/ gnyis pa lcags phur ro/ gsum pa snying dkar nag mtshams su gdab ste/ semasakyi dbyings phyung ba'o/ bzhi pa pho nya ni/ hūm̐ḥ sa bdag chen po'i dus la bab/ khyed dam tshig mthu rtsal phyung ba'i/ lnga pa 'phyong ni/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin tu rlog ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: drug pa sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kī lī sogs nas/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces so/ bdun pa (229) phyag rgya ni brdung tshul bya'o/ brgyad pa rdzas ni/ mi'i rje ngar dang chu so rdo rje tho ba/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa smin phrag tu brdung ngo*/ dgungs teing nge 'jin ni/ snying ka nas tho ba thogs pa mang pos brdung bar bsam mo/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ ho/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bden pas dgra bo che ge mo rdul du rlog cig phye mar gyis shig thal bar rlog cig ces brjod do/ drug pa zhal du bstabs sa la bcu/ dang po gnye po stobs kyi lha stobs po che'o/ pa ra sogs las kyi lha btsan gyi bstabs pa'o/ gnyis pa skyer phur/ gsum pa gdab pa lte ba srid pa bskyed pa'i sa bon gzhon pa'o/ bzhi pa pho nya/ hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig mthu rtsal phyung ba'i/ lnga pa 'phyong ba ni/ bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis/ pa ra brgyan hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa'o/ drug pa sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kī li sogs nas/ bhindha ya bhindha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bdun pa phyag rgya ni stabs pa'i tshul lo/

brgyad pa rdzas ni e khang gru gsum du liṅka bskyur ba'o/ yang na zhal du bstabs sam thod ngan nang du gzhug go dgu pa ting nge 'jin ni/ hūm̐ḥ gsum gyi gtso bo'i zhal du gsol/ (230)phaṭaḥ gsum gyi khro mo'i zhal du dang*/ haḥ gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gsum dgyes par bsam mo/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ dgra bo che ge mo khro bo dang khro mo dam can srung ma dang bcas pa'i zhal du stobs cig: ces brjod des dkyus khong khrar btang ste/ bzhi mgo la btang gsum dkyus su btang gcig mjug tu btang ba'i tshul lo/ gnyis pa lung gi dgongs pa mthar dbyung ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ bdag cag rnal 'byor bsgrub pa pos: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshos pa: rig 'jin bdag cag rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams: dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba'i rigs: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshigs nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod: ces bskul nas gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas: phur pa sras mchog tu gsal te/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ gyi sngags brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi spyi bor hūm̐ ka ra dkar po re/ de'i spyi bor āḥdakar po/ phur pa'i (231)rtse mor āḥdakar po/ gzas pa po'i snying gar āḥdakar po bsam pa ni/ a dkar bya dkar gyi dgongs pa'o/ de nas yang oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ gyi sngags brjod pas/ hūm̐ kā rā yab yum āḥbacas zhu bas bdag nyid la gsum po'i lus shel bum 'o mas gang ba ltar song nas sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ yang phur pa nas gang gis ma reg pa tsam du gzas po'i snying gar bsgril bas/ phur rtse aḥlas 'od zer dang a phra mo yungs 'bru tsam mang po 'phros/ gzas pa so'i snying ga'i aḥlas kyang 'od zer 'phros/

'od phar tshur du 'phros pas kho'i sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa kho'i khrus lung ngo*/ de ni bdag dang phur pa gzas pa po gsum dgongs pa gcig gi 'brel/ dam tshig gcig gis 'brel/ chos nyid gcig gis 'brel bas thugs rjes 'brel thag gi dgongs pa'o/ tsha lung la gsum gyi dang po byung tshor gyi sko bkag pa la/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya che ge mo sarba bhignan bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces kho'i mig rna ba sna lce lus kyi sgo rnams la nas gang gis ma reg par btab pas/ dbang po yul lnga'i byung tshor 'gags te sgo lnga'i rnam shes de sbra dkar gyi (232)chon thag gtub pa bzhin tu kun gzhi la 'dus par bsam/ gnyis pa sems kyi dbyings byung ba la/ dang po sngags bzlas shing*/ phur pas bsdig pas kho'i sha khrag dang snying dkar nag 'brel ba phaṭa gsum gyis dral/ de nas phur bu'i 'od kyis kho'i snying dkar nag gi mtshams na khrag gi sbal ba mthe bong tsam pa bsregs/ de'i nang na khrag gi dwangs ma mtshal lcog la 'dra ba skam/ rtsa yi dwangs ma rgyus pa bsdad pa'i 'dra ba dral/ dbugs kyi dwangs ma gser sa 'og sbas pa'i rlang pa tsam yod pa 'thor/ de gsum gyi dbus na kun gzhi'i rnam shes a thung gi rnam par gnas pa la phur pa slebs

pa gnad slebs pa'o/ de nas sngags brjod cing phur pa btab pas kho'i rnam shes a thung du yod pa rdo khab len gyis lcags phye babasdus pa'am/ star tshan la sbur 'du ba'am/ nyi tshan la mar 'du ba ltar phur pa'i rtse mor 'dus pa ni rtog pa blang ba zhes bya'o/ de'i shul du phur pa gzhan zhig btab pas kho'i rnam shes ldog pa med par byed do/ kun gzhi rtsad nas gcod pa zhes bya'o/ de nas phur pa'i rtse mong kho'i rnam shes a bkrag mdangs dang (233)ldan pa la reg pas tshe dang bsod nams bcas te tshur bdag la bstim te/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ lan gsum brjod de/ bdag gi gnas gsum du reg pas kho'i tshe dang bsod nams bdag la thim bdag bkrag mdangs dang ldan par bsam tshe lung ngo*/ des ni kho'i tshe bsod thob pas mi pham la/ kho'ang sdig pa dag pas mi phab ste gnyis ka 'tshe nus pa'i mu yin no/ de nas phur pa'i rtse mo gyen la bstan te gnas spar ba'i cho ga bya ste/ lag mthil ya gcig gis phur pa bu nas gyen la gdab pa dang*/ bdag gi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rlung har gyis byung te a a zhes sngags bzlas pa gsum gyis kho'i rnam shes a thung de me stag yar ba ltar song te rigs lnga yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su rigs lnga'i sras su skye bar bsam mo/ skye yang skye ste rten 'brel gyi shugs yin no/ chos nyid kyi bden pa yin no/ gsum pa gdab pa'i las dngos bstan pa ni/ gtso phur blang ste yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlab te bdag nyid bsrung ba'i phur pa byas te mchod bstod byas gyin bzhugs su gsol/ de nas spyir sgrub phur brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha phur nga gcig gdab phur nyer gcig (234) mgyogs pur brgyad cu tham pa/ sil phur grangs med/ bzlog phur bcu gnyis rnams las gdab phar nyer gcig ste/ khro bcu'i phur pa bcu/ sgo ma bzhi'i phur pa bzhi/ mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug sras mchog badzra 'dus pa'i phur pa dang nyer gcig rnams gdab pa'o/

dang po bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ hūm̐ḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ bdag nyid chen po'i dus la bab/ sa bdag chen po'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed cing*/ gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams/ mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*/ lus ngag rdul du bshigs nas kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod/ ces bskul nas/ gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya na maḥs manta ka ya wākka tsirta badzra nan badzra (235)kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: da ha da ha che ge mo ma ra ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces rnam par rgyal ba'i phur pa ma byin len pa'i gnas yin pa'i mig gnyis la gdab/ de bzhin tu dbu gnon gyi sngags kun la 'gres te/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: dbugs sngon gyi phur pa log lta'i gnas sna gnyis gdab/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces gshin rje gshed kyi phur pa srog gcod spong ba'i gnas rna ba gnyis la gdab/ ma tha ma tha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kyis mi g.yo ba'i phur pa rdzun smra ba'i gnas lce la gdab/ dzwa la dzwa la badzra sa rta mgrin gyi phur pa ngag 'khyal spong ba'i gnas mgrin par gdab/ pu ru pu ru badzra sa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phur pa phra ma'i gnas gsang bar gdab po/ mu ru mu ru badzra bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phur pa mi tshangs spyod kyi gnas zhes pa 'dug tshig rtsub kyi gnas dpung ba g.yas g.yon la gdab/ ka tam ka ye ja ye bhi ja ye badzra sa khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phur pa gnod sems kyi gnas dpyi g.yas g.yon la gdab/ a ji te a pa ra ji te badzras hūm̐ ka ra'i phur pa mi tshangs tshig rtsub kyi gnas zhes pa'ang spyod pa'i gnas spyi gtsug tu gdab/

ma ra bye na pra mar dha na ye hūm̐ phaṭaḥ stobs po che'i phur pa brnab sems spong ba'i gnas rkang mthil du gdab pas de dag ni mi dge ba rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir ro/ de nas tshad (236) med bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir sgo ma bzhi'i phur pa lus kyi mtsho bzhi la gdab ste/ oṃ badzra kī li lī la ya kun la 'gres te bi ta ya bing bing hūm̐ phaṭa lcags kyu ma'i phur pa blo snying dbugs kyi mtsho la gdab/ na maḥ sa manta hring hring hūm̐ phaṭa: zhags pa ma'i phur pa de mchin pa khrag gi mtsho la gdab/ su ru su ru pra su hūm̐ phaṭa: lcags sgrogs ma'i phur pa len tang rus pa'i mtsho la gdab/ mā ra ya ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kyis dril bu ma'i phur pa klad pa byang sems kyi mtsho la gdab/ de nas phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i phyir mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug gdab pa ni/ snga ma las drug bya ba dang*/ 'dir gan srug gcod pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yin pas/ has ra ya'i sngags kyis khrag gi gnad gcod pa seng ldong gi phur pa spyi gtsug a be sha ya'i sngags dbugs kyi gnad gcod pa bya rgod kyi phur pa rkang mthil bhri ghraṃ gyi sngags kyis 'byung ba bzhi'i gnad gcod pa mchog phur gsang gnas/ dzwa la sa ya'i sngags kyis rtsa bzhi'i gnad gcod pa tsanda kyi phur pa lce dkyil ta thā ya'i sngags kyis tshe'i gnad gcod pa lcags phur snying gar/ bī da ya'i sngags kyi phyi 'od kyi gnad gcod pa skyer ba'i phur pa lte bar gdab po/ de nas thams cad kyi mjug tu sras mchog badzra 'dus pa'i phar pa snying dkar nag gi mtshams su gdab pa ni/ phur pa la byugs (237) bdun brab gsum byas te/ hūm̐ḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas bzhin/ mngon spyod phrin las myur du mjod/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bhignan bhandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ briḥtri sha truṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

ces snying dkar nag gi mtshams su gdab ste cho khrus kyi dgongs pa ltar gdab po/ lnga pa gtun du brdung ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ brdung shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ rdo rje tho bas brdung byas te/ lha yang rung ste brlag par gyis/ bri tri sha truṃ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ drug pa ling ro gtor ma la bran te/ hūm̐ḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byedan/ stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ glad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ zhal du stobs po khā ram̐ kha hiḥ bri tri sha truṃ bhandha ya bhandha ya hūm̐ (238)phaṭaḥ de ni phur pa stod smad kyi 'phyong gi gdab tshul mtshon pa'i phyir bkod pa'o/ bdun pa bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: bya grub ye shes karma he ru ka: phrag dog 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po ste: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di rol la: rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: sems dang sems byung rgyu 'bras 'chol ba las: byung ba'i nad gdon chags chen nyam nga dang : phyi nang 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i rkyen: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug dang : byad phur rbod gtong than ltas ngan pa kun: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mjad du gsol: hūm̐ḥ rnam thar sgo gsum thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: phrin las drag po'i rol pa cir yang snang : sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang : dgod dang gshed dang 'jigs par ston pa dang : snying rje rngam zhi rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha: bdud bzhi'i stan la 'gying bas dpa' ba'i nyams: dur khrod chas (239)(240)dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di rol la:

rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: sems dang sems byung rgyu 'bras 'chol ba las: byung ba'i nad gdon chags chen nyam nga dang : phyi nang 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i rkyen: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug dang : byad phur rbod gtong than ltas ngan pa kun: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mjad du gsol: (241)brgyad ldan pas shin tu sgeg: sku che yan lag rags pas 'jigs su rung : g.yas zhal dkar la rngam pa ha ha rgod: g.yon zhal dmar la gdengs ba dgra la gshed: dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa log 'dren za: rdo rje khros pa'i thugs ni zhe sdang gcod: rgyud drug snying rje'i 'dul bas shin tu zhi: gar dgu gdug pa 'dul phyir dbyings nas bzhengs: bde ba'i sku la chos nyid bskyed pa'i yum: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs srid pa'i 'dod chags 'joms: zhe sdang tshul gyis rū dra tshar gcod pa'i: sgrol yum e ka tsa ti'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ bde stong gnyis med sbyor ba'i mkha' klong las: rtog tshogs sprul par shar ba'i sras mchog ni: rdo rje rin chen padma de bzhin gshegs: las kyi rigs chen dkyil 'khor yongs rjogs bdag: srid pa rdo rje phar pa sgrub pa'i dbyibs: zur gsum dpal gyis dug gsum rtsa ba gcod: sbal sbrul sdom sdig mang po klu gshed 'bebs: 'gro ba rgyud lnga'i rtog (242)pa dbyings su gcod: dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ mi dge bcu po gnas su dag pa las: phyogs mtshams steng 'og 'dul ba'i khro bo bcu: dge ba bcu yi yum dang gnyis med sbyor: kun gzhi tshogs brgyad 'dul phyir dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ steng gi phyogs nas tshangs pa 'dul ba'i lha: ye shes lnga ldan khro rgyal hūm̐ ka ra: brag cha lta bu'i sgra 'byin yum dang sbyor: ma rig tha rgod glog pa'i phag gi mgo:

'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab skem byed rmimag bu'i gdong : steng phyogs lha gdon 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ shar gyi phyogs nas dri za 'dul ba'i lha: 'od gsal bdud 'jigs khro bo rnam par rgyal: snang byed chen mo rdo rje snyems ma 'khril: snang ba dbang bsgyur phra men stag mgo can: thogs med nam mkha' lta bu'i bya rgod gdong : shar gyi gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ (243)hūm̐ḥ shar lho mtshams nas me lha 'dul ba'i lha: log rtog 'joms byed dbyugs pa sngon po ste/ gnyis med zung 'jug rdo rje sderamos 'khril: rnam par mi rtog phra men g.yag mgo can: chos dbyings rnam dag phyag brnyan bya rog gdong : shar lho'i gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ lho yi phyogs nas yi dwags 'dul ba'i lha: gzung 'jin gnyis med khro rgyal gshin rje gshed: mkha' dbyings rnam dag dur khrod bdag mos 'khril: skye 'gags gnyis med phra men sha ba'i mgo: mi shes mun pa la gzigs 'ug pa'i gdong : lho yi gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ lho nub mtshams nas bden bral 'dul ba'i lha: rdo rje lta bur brtan pa'i mi g.yo ba: thabs shes zung 'jug gtun khung yum dang 'khril: thig le nyag gcig phra men gzig gi mgo: sdug bsngal mtshang brtol gsod byed kha ta'i gdong : lho nub gdon tshogs (244)'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ nub kyi phyogs nas chu bdag 'dul ba'i lha: sgra snyan lta bur 'tsher ba'i rta mchog dpal: thig le stong pa'i bdag nyid gtum mo 'khril: rtsol sgrub zil gnon phra men byi la'i mgo: 'jab phur thabs shes 'brel ba'i su shud mgo: nub gyi gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ

nub byang mtshams nas rlung lha 'dul ba'i lha: nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs gzhan las rgyal: mtshan ma'i rnam rtog 'bigs byed mda' snyems 'khril: 'khril sbyor dbyings su dag pa'i spyang ki dang : yang dag nyid lta gsod byed khra yi gdong : nub byang gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i lha: bde ba chen po bdud rtsi dbyings su 'khyil: gcig dang du bral rlung 'byin yum dang 'khril: zhe sdang skyon gyis mi 'jigs seng ge'i mgo: dug gsum mtha' la mi (245)gnas pha waṃ gdong : byang gi gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bges sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ byang shar mtshams nas dbang ldan 'dul ba'i lha: dus gsum khams gsum kun las rnam par rgyal: gzung 'jin gnyis rtog gsod byed yum dang 'khril: pra men spyod pa brlang po dom gyi mgo: gang du mi gnas dug shog sre mong gdong : byang shar gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ḥ 'og gi phyogs nas sa bdag 'dul ba'i lha: don dam bden pa la gnas stobs po che: mkha' dbyings klong du bskyed byed yum dang 'khril: mtha' la mi gnas ye shes thogs med dred: chom rkun las kyi gshogs can byi ba'i gdong : 'og phyogs gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs sogs 'gres so/ jaḥrtogs pas snang ba dbang sdud lcags kyu ma: byams pa chen pos dgra bgegs gnad nas 'gugs: bsod nas ye shes tshogs ldan su shud mgos: yul (246)la mngon par rtog pa dgug tu gsol: hūm̐ḥ stong pa bco brgyad ldan pa'i zhags pa ma: snying rje chen pos log 'dren rnam shes 'ching : rtog med don la sbyor ba skya ka'i mgos: chags sdang nyon mongs dgra sde 'ching du gsol: bam̐: yod med rtag chad spangs ba'i lcags sgrogs ma: dga' ba chen pos shes sgrib dbyings su sdoms:

chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba'i srin bya'i mgos: gzung 'jin ye shes dbyings su sdom du gsol: hoḥ shes rab pha rol phyin mjad dril bu ma: btang snyoms chen pos grags stong chos sku sbyongs: sgom pa'i lam las mi ldog khra yi mgos: 'gyur med chos sku'i dbyings la myos par mjod: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: sems dang sems byung rgyu 'bras 'chol ba las: byung ba'i nad gdon chags chen nyams nga dang : phyi nang 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i rkyen: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug dang : byad phur rbod gtong than (247)ltas ngan pa kun: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mjad du gsol: hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi phur srung dus la bab: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ni: phyogs bzhir rgyug cing chong nge 'don: rtag tu sha dang khrag la rngam: nang nub sems can 'bum 'bum za: gang du mnos par yud kyis slebs: de 'dra'i lcags kyi spyang mo la: lcags kyi shwa na mu kha zhon: shar lho nub byang kun tu rgyug: dri za gshin rje klu dbang dang : gnod sbyin 'khor bcas dmyal thag chod: mtshams bzhi steng 'og rgyug tsa na: so so'i dmag dpung dbang du byed: bstan pa 'jigs pa'i dgra bo dang : kun la 'tshe ba'i gdon tshogs kyi: srog dbugs za ba'i dus la bab: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐ḥ dpa' chen phur bu'i srung ma ni: lcags kyi spyang mo rkang gsum ma: mgyogs pa'i dbang gis stong gsum bskor: rlung gi shugs kyis thams cad gnon: rdzu 'phrul ri rab thal ba rlog: de 'dra'i lcags (248)kyi khyi mo la: lcags kyi shwa na mu kha zhon: dbu la g.yag mgo thod du bcing : rdzi rno stong gsum kun la gzigs: sum cu rtsa gsum dbang du sdud: phyogs bzhi'i rgyal chen bran du khol: bstan pa bshigs pa'i dgra bo dang :

lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i gdon: gang la dmigs pa khyod shes kyis: myur du gsod pa'i dus la bab: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐ḥ dpal chen phur ba'i srung ma ni: zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma: nyi ma zla ba dbang du sdud: sran po'i don snying sbar gyis 'debs: de 'dra'i zangs kyi wa mo la: zangs kyi sri la mu kha zhon: sku ni zangs zhun me stag 'phro: 'jol ber dmar nag lhab lhub g.yo: dur khrod kun tu rgyug cing brgyal: dgra bo'i sha dang khrag la rngams: bgegs rnams dus ma yin par gsod: thun dmar 'bebs shing dal yams gtong : khyod kyis mi sgrol ci yang med: sgrol byed chen po'i dus la babs: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong (249)bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐ḥ dpal chen phur bu'i srung ma ni: gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad de: phyogs mtshams brgyad du brkyang ba'i lce: rdo rje rin chen padma dang : rgya gram me dang ral gri dang : mda' mdung drag po mtshon gyis lces: phyogs mtshams gdon tshogs zil gyis gnon: de 'dra'i gser gyi 'phar ba la: gser gyi sri la mu kha zhon: shar lho nub byang khus btab nas: srid gsum srog la ngu zhing zug: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: nang khro 'byin pa'i dus la bab: bzhi ka'ang sprul pa yang sprul dag : nying sprul rang rang gzugs can 'gyings: stong gsum 'gengs shing dmigs pa sgrol: lag pa g.yas na phur pa dang : g.yon pa lcags kyus dgra snying 'byin: rol du khyi spyang 'phar ba khridaḥ nyams pa gang yin snying rtsa chod: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐ḥ rang rgyud can du ston pa'i tshe: sa bdag chen mo bzhi ru ston: de byin gza' (250)yi bu mo ser: sku mdor ser nag ber nag gsol/ ral ba nyil zhing gza' rnams sdud: gza' 'dul king king zil gyis gnon:

chibs su gza' rta zhur po chibs/ gza' rgod 'dul ba'i dus la bab: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐: bswe byin btsan gyi bu mo ni: chibs su btsan rta dmar po chibs: dmar nag ber chen sku la gsol: btsan rnams dbang sdud zil gyis gnon: snyan cha rin chen gser du 'khrol: ba spu lcags kyu ltar 'jings pas: nyams pa bzung nas 'chor mi srid: btsan rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐: ya byin bdud kyi bu mo ni: mthing nag bdud rta sngon po chibs: rang mdog ber chen sku la gsol: ral pa phur pa'i lan tshar can: g.yas na gri thogs dam nyams bsha': g.yon pas mi snying rtse nas za: shan pa chen pa'i dus la bab: bdud kyi sde tshogs cham la (251)phob: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐ḥ yag byin klu yi bu mo ljang : klu rta rang mdog chibs su chib: ljang nag ber dang ral pas brgyan: ba spu 'jin cing cod paṇa 'phur: klu rnams dbang sdud zil gyi gnon: gsum ka'ang phur pa lcags kyu bsnams: rang rang rigs kyi gdon tshogs 'dul: dam nyams sgrol ba'i dus la bab: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐: bdag nyid chen mo re ma ti: chibs su bya rgyal khyung la chibs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs gdug pa sgrol: khyung la mnga' mjad sprul pa 'gyed: srid pa gsum yang sder mos gnon: ma rung 'byung po thal bar rlog: chag che nyam nga byad phur dag : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid chen mo re ma ja: chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs: zhing lpags rlon pa'i g.yang gzhi gsol: gdug pa rtsad gcod srin mo'i chas: sprul pa rlung nag 'tshubs ma 'gyed: dam nyams bsgral ba'i (252)dus la bab: chag che nyang nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod:

hūm̐: bdag nyid chen mo re ma ju: chibs su chu glang sngon po chibs: nad do cog gi sna 'dren cing : 'byung po thams cad zil gyis gnon: nyi ma zla ba dbang du sdud: kha rlangs thams cad nad du 'bar: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐: bdag nyid chen mo re ma ti: chibs su dril rta rkang gsum chibs: sku dmog nag mo 'jigs pa la: sku la glog gi me stag 'phro: spyan mig dmar po zangs su 'bar: gang du bltas pa me ru 'bar: rakṣa srin po'i don snying 'byin: ral ba bsigs pas stong khams 'khrugs: kun kyang phur pa khram shing 'jin: chibs kyi snga long phyi long la: mtshon gru nad rkyal shwa dhe'u bkal: sprul pa stong gsum khyab par 'gyed: dam nyams bsgral ba'i dus la bab: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod: hūm̐: rang rang rigs kyi ming po ni: (253)rgyal po dkar po ging dkar phur: bse yi skyes bu dmar po 'jigs: bse mda' bse gzhu phur pa 'dril: ma hā ka la mdog nag ste: be con phur pa rgyan dang ldan: chibs sam yang na rkyang par ston: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : dkon mchog sku dgra dben rtsa 'joms: chos khrims 'dral dang slob dpon dgra: rnal 'byor 'joms pa la sogs pa: bsad dang dbab dang nang ngan gyis: ci nas brlag par khyod kyis kyis: chag che nyam nga byad phur dang : rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mjod:

ces bar btang*/ brgyad pa thun gtor ni/ hūm̐: bzlog byed dpal chen rol pa'i lha: bzlog bsgyur las mjad dus la babs: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: sngon las 'phra rkyen bar chad bgegs: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sogs: bkra mi shes pa'i dngos po dang : phyi nang drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon: ban bon mu stegs rigs sngags byad/ gshin rje 'khor lo ma mo'i khram: phur pa'i dbal kha bon po'i btso: kla klo'i g.yul dang ngan sngags (254)sbyor: lha srin khros dang gdon chen zug: sdebs bshor hom dang thun zor mnan: gtad khram rbod gtong rbad 'dre dang : mi kha gleng gzhi 'thab rtsod mchu: keg sri than ltas ngan pa kun: bstan pa bshigs pa'i dgra bo dang : yongs la gnod pa'i bgegs gdon sogs: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i steng du bhyo: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: bsgyur ro za kha dgra la bsgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las mjod: ces spu gri'i sngags kyis 'phong : dgu pa sgo dbye ni: rgab dkris bsal nas zor lam btod la/ hūm̐: dpal chen phur pa'i dkyil 'khor na: phyag rgya bzhi ldan sgo srung rnams: thugs rje'i thabs kyi phyag rgya dang : stong nyid shes rab dgongs pa yis: pho brang gnyen po'i sgo dbye zhig: phur pa rol pa'i lha tshogs rnasam: dbyings la rtsol rtog mi mnga' yang : byams pa chen pos gdul dka' rnams: snying rje'i mthu yis sgrol ba'i phyir: dga' chen rol pa gar dgu'i nyams: btang snyoms chen po'i klong nas bskyod: bskyod dang bskyod byed mi mnga' yang : dmar chen gtor ma chen pa dang : gnyis (255)med rol pa'i dmags dpung 'di/ brgya byin g.yul ngor chas pa 'dra/ ri rab dag kyang mgo 'jug ldog: rgya mtsho 'chol zhing skar 'tshogs 'khrugs/ lha min mgo bo 'gas byed na: sdang ba'i dgra la smos ci 'tshal: de phyir pho brang sgo phyes la: shul lam dgra bo'i phyogs su ston:

bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: bcu pa gzhi bdag la phog thug sel phyir brngan sbyin gser skyems ni: bla gab med pa'i sa nas: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcur: gnas pa'i tshe dgu gnyan dgu rnams: dbang phyug nga yi zor lam la: ru nga prag dog mi mjad cing : steng gi nyi zla dgra gcan nas: 'og gi sa bdag lte 'phyo'i bar: rtag chags lha srin gnyen po la: zor sna gtad pa'i gnas med kyi: steng na bzhugs pa zhabs sdus shig: brngan du dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul: bar du bzhugs pa logs su bshol: brngam du g.yu sngon phud kyis bran: 'og na bzhugs pa dbu chum cig: brngan du gtor ma (256)gser skyems 'bul: bdag gi zor sna gnyen po'i lam: phyogs rnams rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings: brgyud nas dam nyams dgra bo dang : rgyal ba'i bka' la mi nyan pa'i: 'byung po'i tshogs la 'phangs ba'i phyir: las kyi sdong grogs gnyen po mjod: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mjod: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing gser skyems phyogs bcur 'thor ro/ bcu gcig pa zor bskul ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen rol pa'i pho nya rnams: mig nas khrag gi tshwa tshwa 'phro: kha nas bhyo bzlog phaṭa sgra sgrogs: ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gseb na: khro chu khol ma'i skyin thang 'bebs: rkang lag lcags kyi sder mo yis: gnam pa med par sbar kyis 'debs: ri klung med par rjes kyis 'gengs: zas su sems can gson po za: brnag pa'i gnas su yud kyis phyin: gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs gnyis: ma thogs myur du khrid la shog: dang po zhe sdang pha yis bskyed: bar du 'dod chags ma yi mngal: de nas dri za (257)nye bar 'khor: tha ma nyon mongs dug lnga'i rten: phung po khams dang skye mched dang : tshogs brgyad rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir: klad pa'i dkyil du rdo zar ya: nyan pa'i rna la mtshe zor ya: lta ba'i mig la mda' zor ya: snom pa'i sna la khrag zor ya:

smra ba'i lce la phur zor ya: dran pa'i snying la dug zor ya: 'gro ba'i rkang la mtshon zor ya: yul mkhar khyim la mi zor ya: nor gyi dbyig la skong zor ya: 'og gi rta la rtsang zor ya: mchan gyi bu la yungs zor ya: rab chad dud pas skye rgyud chodaḥ ri rung phung pas yul mkhar bskyel: rkong zor 'bar bas cham la phob: tshon skud sna lngas byad du chug: tsher ma'i shing gis gdon gdug slongs: mda' khras skyes pa gri 'thab sbyor: 'phang khras bud med dug sbyor g.yos: lcags zangs dug khrag myos su chug: khram shing gshin rje'i kha ru rdzongs: lo zla zhag tu ma 'gyang bar: ming tsam med par phung du chug: tsirta ku lu nan: tsakra raṃ: shag (258)shag raṃ: kha hi raṃ: su tri ni: ja tri ja: ya ya: bar dang*/ de nas chad mdo byer ro/ gong gi thun gtor gyi tshig gis thebs dang dgra phyogs la zor kha gtad/ zor rjes gcod pa'i srung 'khor bsgom/ bstan skyong dang bro mnan gzhung las shes so/ 'di ltar snga 'gyur mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi/ gsang ba'i mjod khang rigs pa'i tha raṃ can/ dri med rnam dpyod shes rab lde'u mig gis/ legs par phye ba dam pa'i bka' drin lags/ brgyud gsum thugs kyi nying khu snying thig gter/ dpyad gsum dag pa'i sra bur legs bstar ba/ o rgyan thugs dam rdo rje phur ba yi/ smad las gdab pa las kyi khrigs 'di spel/ dung dang sad rtsa ltar dkar legs byas kyis/ 'gro kun nang gi mun pa mthar byas te/ rig pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa de/ mngon gyur gdod ma'i mgon dang ro gcig shog: ces pa'ang mchog sprul kun tu bzang pos: klong chen snying thig gi phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon gyi/ smad las zur du bkol ba zhig yang yang bskul ba'i ngor chos kyi bdag po 'od gsal rin chachen snying po padma las 'brel rtsal gyis dben khrod ljon pa lung nas sug bris su bgyis pas dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs kun khyab par gyur cig gu
